$comment: CLS-1000 component map: a multi-repo federation. Each flow lists today's carrier (what the consumer reads now) and, where a data record moves, the ExchangeEnvelope record_type it will use. Details of other repositories come from this repo's importers and NC_DESK_TEAM_PROMPT.md, the CLS-1000/notitia-civica README, and, for gatepost's repository name, the maintainer. See docs/ecosystem-exchange.md.
envelope_adoption: defined; no component emits or consumes envelopes yet

components.role: OSINT intelligence engine. Its records carry an analysis tier, and model hypotheses are unverified.
Civic records monitor for Oregon and Washington. Each record carries its own evidence tier and origin (live, cache or fixture).
Replays Oregon Legislature OLIS action histories through a rule table to find procedural outcomes.
Produces 'gatepost brief' Markdown summaries of signals.
components.repository_note: Named by the maintainer. No file or commit in this repo mentions it.

components.role: Seals sources into custody, triages leads, runs the editorial desk and human sign-off, and exports verified articles.
The public publication and live site. It holds hand-published briefs, explainers, methodology and the source register, and it receives the newsroom's built reader pages.
components.source_in_newsroom_note: web_public/ is the Astro source for the verified-article pages. It is built in the newsroom repo, and moving the build onto the live site is a manual step for the maintainer (NC_DESK_TEAM_PROMPT.md). It is not a copy of CLS-1000/notitia-civica, which has no Astro project.

code_dependencies.kind: runtime import: loads replay_harness.py from a proc_track checkout with importlib and runs it
code_dependencies.remedy: proc_track publishes chamber_flow records (envelopes), so the newsroom reads data instead of running proc_track's code

flows.carrier: spec1_intelligence.jsonl, plus an optional cls_verdicts verdicts.jsonl
flows.notes: Only analysis_tier='llm_verified' records are imported. A record whose latest human verdict is 'incorrect' is skipped.
Only live and cache origins are public records. INFERRED records never pass the evidence bar.

flows.carrier: a proc_track checkout read offline: cache/<session>.json and replay_harness.py
flows.notes: Only completed replays with a notable outcome (veto, veto override, line-item veto, law without signature) become leads.
Not imported: signal lines name a source but carry no URL, so nothing can be sealed. An envelope payload with source URLs would make this flow possible.

flows.carrier: Markdown briefs (briefs/spec1_brief_YYYY-MM-DD.md) and briefs/brief_index.jsonl in CLS-1000/notitia-civica
flows.notes: Per the CLS-1000/notitia-civica README. Published as written; this repo is not involved.
Only signed, human-approved articles whose proof hash still matches are exported.
export_verified.py writes this file once the Five-Mask Standards branch (PR #14) is merged. Until then the site reads it but the exporter does not write it.

flows.carrier: the built web_public/ site (astro build output)
flows.notes: Manual: the maintainer moves the build onto the live site. Nothing in this repo pushes to CLS-1000/notitia-civica.
